summary: Candidate source identified: the latest inspected ACS 5-year release is 2020–2024. Its official API documents profiles with broad social, economic, housing and demographic information, including counts and percentages across places, counties and tracts. The direct New Brunswick query could not be inspected in this research pass, so no local values or successful acquisition are claimed. This is discovery only, not dataset acquisition.

sources.title: American Community Survey 5-Year Data 2024
sources.geography: United States; API dataset documentation lists states, counties, places and tracts. Target geography: New Brunswick city, New Jersey (state FIPS 34; place code 51210), subject to confirming geography codes and API response.
sources.period: 2020–2024 ACS 5-year estimates; release page says this window is comparable to 2015–2019, with topic-specific comparability notes and variable changes to review.
sources.grain: Aggregate estimate by geography and profile variable; counts and percentages. Estimate and margin-of-error fields are represented by variable suffixes such as E and M, to be checked against the selected variable metadata before acquisition.
useful_fields: ACS profile counts and percentages for demographic, social, economic and housing characteristics
Age, language, health insurance coverage, disability, commuting and housing profile variables
Estimate and margin-of-error fields, after variable-level verification
observed_facts: The Census release page provides 2024 ACS 5-year profile API examples and links to variables, examples, technical documentation and supported geography.
The official API dataset page describes broad social, economic, housing and demographic coverage, counts and percentages, and includes nation, states, counties, places and tracts.
The Census release page cautions that variables may change; it directs users to a 2024 changes document and topic-specific comparability information.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Bounded acquisition: query only New Brunswick city (state:34, place:51210) from the verified 2024 ACS 5-year profile endpoint. First inspect the 2024 variable metadata for the exact age, language, insurance, disability, commuting and housing fields and their E/M counterparts; request names, estimates, margins of error and geography identifiers in a bounded set of calls. Save the raw response with retrieval time, URL, hash and geography/vintage metadata; retain suppressed or unknown values as returned. This agent did not validate the place code or successfully inspect a local API response.
limitations: Direct query URL was inaccessible through this research tool; local data availability and exact response shape remain unverified.
Profile variables may not expose every desired detail; select variables only after checking 2024 metadata.
ACS estimates describe residents within defined Census geographies; they do not identify hospital users, service areas or catchments.
This is a public-source discovery lead, not an acquired dataset; no local estimate is reported.

simulation_use: If independently acquired and reviewed, use ACS counts and percentages with margins of error as resident population denominators and demographic context for the named geography. Preserve the 2020–2024 window and geographic vintage. Do not infer hospital utilization, catchment, or referral patterns from city or county boundaries.
limitations: Only Census primary sources were searched and opened; no complementary patient-origin or hospital-user dataset was verified in this bounded pass.
